solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Lay and consecrated ground excluding Noel Coward

indicators.note: ground means crushed and reworked, and excluding says some of the shuffled letters are set aside as the named word

explanation.surface: A layman and a patch of holy earth somehow kept the playwright Noel Coward out.
explanation.walkthrough: Mix the letters of LAY and CONSECRATED; take out the letters of NOEL and the rest rearrange into the answer. 'Noel Coward' looks like one name, but Coward is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A coward is a timid, easily frightened person, which is the playground insult used for a fearful child.

clue.text: Nightmare takes toll on soldiers

parts.note: a bell's toll is its chime
RA is the Royal Artillery, soldiers

explanation.surface: A bad dream in which a bell rings out over troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A chimera is a monstrous fancy or horror, a fearful dream-like illusion.

clue.text: Sit on marsupial's tummy opening

parts.note: a roo is a kangaroo, a marsupial, and the 's adds S

indicators.note: opening says take the first letter of tummy

explanation.surface: A baby kangaroo settles at the mouth of its mother's pouch.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds settle on a perch to sleep, which is to sit for the night.

clue.text: Indifferent, although cheated death unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly says the letters of cheated land in a surprising new order

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for death, as in birth and death dates

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs, unmoved, despite having cheated death out of the blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Being detached is being aloof and uninvolved, uncaring about the outcome.

clue.text: Mayor's deception goes wrong — not worth it?

indicators.note: goes wrong says the letters of the two words are jumbled

explanation.surface: A mayor's fraud collapses, so was it worth it?
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says wrongdoing never pays off in the end, so it is not worth the risk.

clue.text: Take too much in gallery until now

indicators.note: in says the overdose goes inside the gallery

parts.note: the Tate is the London art gallery
to OD is to overdose, take too much

explanation.surface: Overdoing it in an art gallery, up to the present.
explanation.definitionFit: Up to the present moment, as in so far, is the idiom.

clue.text: Fruit drop lacks power

indicators.note: lacks says the word for drop goes without the letter for power

parts.note: a slope is a drop, a downward incline
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit fell but lacked any force behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloe is the small dark fruit of the blackthorn, used to flavour gin.

clue.text: Where flights go in move to get around a fine

indicators.note: to get around says the word for move goes round the a

parts.note: to stir is to move
well means fine, in good health

explanation.surface: A traveller moves to dodge a penalty on where airline flights go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flights' suggests aircraft; here it is flights of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Flights of steps run up the vertical shaft that holds a staircase.

clue.text: Result to be disclosed in reverse order

indicators.note: in reverse order says the two words of the phrase swap places

parts.note: to come out is to be disclosed or revealed

explanation.surface: A result is to be announced in reverse order, like a countdown.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is the consequence or end result of something.

clue.text: Spies love an informal welcome

parts.note: the CIA is the American intelligence agency, a body of spies
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Secret agents send their love along with a casual greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Ciao is a casual Italian greeting used for both hello and goodbye.

clue.text: Stranger chord introduces rave

parts.note: a third is a two-note musical interval, loosely a chord
a rave is a big dance party

explanation.surface: A weirder musical chord opens a dance event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stranger' reads as an adjective modifying chord, but it is a noun: an outsider.
explanation.definitionFit: An outside person not directly involved in a deal or dispute is a stranger to it.

clue.text: Delirious from hospital shock treatment and sick inside

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
ECT is electroconvulsive therapy, shock treatment

indicators.note: inside says take only the interior letters of the word sick

explanation.surface: A sick patient raves after electric shock therapy in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A hectic flush is a feverish one, so in an old sense the word means fevered and delirious.

clue.text: Face old, unruly rioter

parts.note: ex- means former, old

indicators.note: unruly says the letters of rioter are out of order

explanation.surface: Confront an old, disorderly rioter.
explanation.definitionFit: The face of a building is its outside surface, its outer front.

clue.text: Coastal city beach that's on journey

parts.note: sand stands for a beach
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is
to go is to journey

explanation.surface: A beach that lies on the route of a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: This Californian port lies on the Pacific near the Mexican border.

clue.text: Haul along Her Majesty to meet performer wearing dress

parts.note: to drag is to haul along
Her Majesty is a queen

explanation.surface: Dragging the Queen to meet an entertainer in a gown.
explanation.definitionFit: A man performing in exaggerated female costume is a stage act of this kind.

clue.text: 6, but not 7, is 7 minus one

indicators.note: minus one says one letter, the first, is dropped from the number

parts.note: the number written out in words

explanation.surface: A little arithmetic: six qualifies, seven does not, and seven less one is six.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites you to treat the numbers as cross-references to other clues; they are just numbers. 'minus one' takes one letter, the S, from SEVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Six divides by two exactly and seven does not, so six has this property and seven lacks it.

clue.text: Working boy's misconduct

parts.note: going means working, as a going concern
a son is a boy; the 's is a link meaning has

explanation.surface: A working lad has been behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspicious or improper happenings are known by this phrase.

clue.text: Mount before travelling west

indicators.note: in an across clue westward is right to left, so the word for before is read backwards

parts.note: ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: Climb on before heading off westward.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount is a title for a mountain, here the Sicilian volcano.

clue.text: Flog turkey by the sixteenth of a pound

parts.note: TR is the international code for Turkey
an ounce is a sixteenth of a pound weight

explanation.surface: Sell a turkey by weighing it by the ounce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flog' suggests selling; here it means beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To trounce is to beat soundly, and to flog is to thrash.

clue.text: Oxford tie features small spade and spike

parts.note: S is the clothing abbreviation for small
a hoe is a digging tool like a spade
to lace a drink is to spike it

explanation.surface: An Oxford college's tie bears a small spade and a spike.
explanation.walkthrough: Oxford looks like the university; here it is an Oxford, a laced leather shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oxford is a lace-up shoe, and the cord that fastens it is what ties it.

clue.text: Vendors heard where wine might be kept

indicators.note: heard says the word for vendors is spoken and matched by sound

parts.note: vendors are sellers

explanation.surface: Merchants were overheard in the wine store.
explanation.definitionFit: Underground rooms for storage are traditional for laying down wine.

clue.text: Technology company involved in kinky activity makes amusing viewing

indicators.note: involved in says the other parts are wrapped inside the letters for kinky activity

parts.note: S and M is sadomasochism, kinky activity
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: A tech firm caught up in kinky goings-on makes for funny television.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation comedy is a television genre built to amuse viewers.

clue.text: Doctors abandon globe to dangerous insect

parts.note: MOs are medical officers, doctors
to quit is to abandon
a globe is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: Doctors give up on the world, leaving it to a deadly bug.
explanation.definitionFit: This biting fly spreads malaria, which makes it one of the deadliest creatures alive.

clue.text: Sodium on tree is cause of fire in vegetation

parts.note: Na is the chemical symbol for sodium
a palm is a tree

explanation.surface: Sodium on a tree causes a blaze in the undergrowth.
explanation.definitionFit: This jellied incendiary was dropped to burn jungle, notably in the Vietnam War.

clue.text: Platforms erected in charity operation

indicators.note: in a down clue erected means set upright, so the pieces read bottom to top

parts.note: aid is charity

explanation.surface: Stages put up for a charity event.
explanation.definitionFit: A podium is a raised stand for a speaker or winner; podia is its plural.

clue.text: Meets to bury mushrooms contaminated with tritium

parts.note: to inter is to bury

indicators.note: contaminated with says the mushrooms have the tritium mixed into them

parts.note: ceps are porcini mushrooms
T is the chemical symbol for tritium

explanation.surface: Gatherings to bury radioactive mushrooms.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a moving thing on its path and stop it is to cut it off.

clue.text: Guard spins around to pull out weapon

indicators.note: spins around says the word for guard is turned to face the other way

parts.note: to ward is to guard, as in ward off

explanation.surface: A sentry whirls round to unsheathe a sword.
explanation.definitionFit: To unholster or unsheathe a gun or sword is the familiar Western sense.

clue.text: Barren meadow faces north

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: An unproductive pasture looks northward.
explanation.definitionFit: Lean years are thin, unproductive ones, so the word means scant or unfruitful.

clue.text: Cooked boneless meat in a new soy sauce

indicators.note: cooked says the gathered letters are worked over into a new form
boneless takes out the T, as in a T-bone steak, from the word meat

explanation.surface: Boned meat cooked in a fresh soy sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boneless' removes T, the T-bone, from MEAT, leaving MEA. Then 'Cooked' mixes MEA with IN, A, N and SOY.
explanation.definitionFit: This cold emulsion of egg yolk and oil is a classic creamy dressing.
